title: 第18章 云州第19章 有客上门
slug: 镇守仙秦地牢吞妖六十年
content_zh:
玉娘六岁时候被卖到花船凝翠舫。
她已经不太记得云州老家，只记得粉好吃，天很蓝。
“我家可能是遇到了截杀，我能记得的就是好多血，我被藏在车架的底下，我都记不得藏我的是爹娘还是谁……”
晃荡的车厢中，伏在张远怀里的玉娘低低说着，身躯止不住的颤抖，似乎是那不愿意想起的画面又被翻出来。
张远伸手圈住她身体，宽厚的身躯将她搂住。
“我爹娘死的时候也是六七岁，是大哥撑起来我们这个家。”
“我记得我爹被送回来时候，满身是血，我只知道哭，大哥没哭，他接过了爹的雁翎刀。”
“大哥死，我也没哭。”
张远的手掌压在一旁的雁翎刀刀鞘上。
玉娘抬头。
“或许，这是老天眷顾，让我们这两个孤单的人在一起？”张远伸手将玉娘的眼泪擦去，然后脸上露出笑容。
“说好，我要是死了，你就将这刀交给咱儿子，让他不准哭。”
张远的话让玉娘微微怔住。
好一会，她方才微微低头。
自己的小郎是皂衣卫。
说这样的话，与吉利不吉利无关。
父死子承。
“那，要是女儿怎么办呢？”话出口玉娘已经感觉不对，抬头时候，看张远一脸笑意的盯着自己。
顿时，她羞红了脸。
“那就再生个儿子。”

“要是还是女儿，那接着生。”
“还是女儿，再接着生。”
“不生不生就不生。”
……
凝翠舫停靠在城外贵庐河上，早上和白天靠岸，晚上点红灯，荡到河中心去，需要小舢板摆渡上船。
与其他花船相比，凝翠舫这样的三层十丈大船显得无比高大。
其上雕琢精细，红漆鲜艳，完全让其他花船抬不起头。
一晚上三五十两都能花销掉，是名副其实的消金窟。
玉娘说，凝翠舫背后有江湖背景，势力不小，具体的她也不清楚，只是到一个地方驻留，本地也无人敢得罪。
这倒确实，一般这种生意若没有足够背景，当真是强龙难压地头蛇的。
“玉姑娘！”
“吆，玉姑娘回来了。”
“小玉。”
两人下车到凝翠舫边上，就有人唤玉娘的名字。
玉娘抬头，面上闪过激动之色。
张远将她手牵着，握的很紧。
两人上船，老鸨已经迎过来。
“我的小玉啊，红姨想你呐。”不知真假，老鸨伸手去拉玉娘的手，眼眶透红。
此时其他人也都迎上来，玉娘看着众人，也是红了眼眶。
“听说玉姑娘被郎君赎走了，嫁了好人家呢。”

“看啊看，这真般配。”
“哎，姑娘家不就图个好归宿吗？”
content_en:
When Yuniang was six years old, she was sold to the flower boat Ningcuifang.
She doesn’t remember much about her hometown in Yunzhou, she only remembers that the noodles are delicious and the sky is blue.
"My family may have been intercepted. All I can remember is a lot of blood. I was hidden under the frame of the car. I can't even remember whether it was my parents or who was hiding me..."
In the swaying carriage, Yu Niang, who was lying in Zhang Yuan's arms, whispered, her body trembling uncontrollably, as if the scene she didn't want to think of was revealed again.
Zhang Yuan reached out and wrapped his arms around her body, hugging her with his generous body.
"My parents were six or seven years old when they died. It was my eldest brother who supported our family."
"I remember that when my father was sent back, he was covered in blood. I just cried. My eldest brother didn't cry. He took my father's Yan Ling Dao."
"I didn't cry when my brother died."
Zhang Yuan's palm pressed against the scabbard of Yan Ling Dao beside him.
Yu Niang raised her head.
"Perhaps this is God's blessing, allowing us two lonely people to be together?" Zhang Yuan stretched out his hand to wipe away Yuniang's tears, and then a smile appeared on his face.
"Say yes, if I die, you will give this knife to our son and ask him not to cry."
Zhang Yuan's words made Yu Niang slightly stunned.
After a while, she lowered her head slightly.
My own young man is Zaoyiwei.
Saying this has nothing to do with whether it is auspicious or unlucky.
The father dies and the son inherits.
"Then, what should I do if I am a daughter?" Yu Niang already felt something was wrong as she spoke. When she raised her head, she saw Zhang Yuan staring at her with a smile on his face.
Suddenly, she blushed.
"Then have another son."
"If it's still a daughter, then let's have another baby."
"It's still a daughter, let's have another baby."
"If there is no birth, there will be no birth."
…
Ningcui Fang is docked on the Guilu River outside the city. It docks in the morning and during the day. At night, it lights up a red light and swings to the center of the river. A small sampan is required to ferry it to the boat.
Compared with other flower boats, a three-story, ten-foot-long boat like Ningcuifang looks extremely tall.
The exquisite carvings and bright red paint make other flower boats unable to lift their heads.
You can spend thirty to fifty taels in one night, it is a veritable money sink.
Yuniang said that Ningcuifang had a political background behind it and was quite powerful. She didn’t know the details. She just stayed in one place and no one in the area dared to offend him.
This is indeed true. Generally speaking, if this kind of business does not have sufficient background, it is really difficult for a strong dragon to defeat a local snake.
"Jade girl!"
"Hey, Miss Jade is back."
"Xiaoyu."
When the two got off the car and walked to Ningcui Boat, someone called Yu Niang's name.
Yu Niang raised her head, excitement flashed across her face.
Zhang Yuan held her hand tightly.
When the two got on the boat, the madam had already come to greet them.
"My Xiaoyu, Aunt Hong misses you." Not knowing whether it was true or not, the Madam stretched out her hand to take Yu Niang's hand, her eyes were red.
At this time, everyone else came up to greet them, and Yu Niang's eyes were red as she looked at everyone.
"I heard that Miss Jade was redeemed by her husband and married into a good family."
"Look, look, it's a perfect match."
"Hey, doesn't the girl's family just want a good home?"
